focus.zh: 台灣及東南亞的先進封裝、伺服器、製程感測與工業供電
focus.en: Advanced packaging, servers, process sensing and industrial power in Taiwan and Southeast Asia

throughline.zh: 精材與台積電訂定先進封裝外包產線，日月光同步公布路竹廠區建設和化學感測系統新採購，技嘉則揭露伺服器營收及馬來西亞產能規劃。
throughline.en: Xintec and TSMC agreed on a new advanced-packaging line, ASE reported a plant milestone and chemical-sensor order, and Gigabyte disclosed server results and plans for its Malaysian production site.

text.zh: 精材與台積電簽至 2033 年底的先進封裝外包協議，並核准擬發行 150 億元轉換公司債，首期量產規劃 2029 年。
text.en: Xintec signed a TSMC packaging outsourcing agreement through end-2033, approved a proposed NT$15bn bond financing and targets initial production in 2029.

text.zh: 日月光路竹廠一期啟用、二期動土；兩期滿載後投資規模估 1,000 億元，實際新增產能尚未量化。
text.en: ASE opened phase one of Luzhu and broke ground on phase two, estimating NT$100bn in investment at full buildout without quantified accepted capacity.

text.zh: 技嘉第三季營收約 1,547 億元、年增 94.4%，前九月伺服器營收占比 78%，新山廠擴產數量未公布。
text.en: Gigabyte's Q3 revenue was approximately NT$154.7bn, up 94.4% YoY; servers were 78% of nine-month sales, with no Johor capacity figures.

text.zh: TSIA 公布第三季半導體產值 2.662 兆元；工研院的全年 9.762 兆元屬預測，記憶體分項不可重複加總。
text.en: TSIA reported NT$2.662tn in Q3 semiconductor output; ITRI's NT$9.762tn annual figure is a forecast and memory subcomponents must not be double-counted.

text.zh: Ainos 公布日月光新增 5,000 台化學感測設備、價值 900 萬美元的採購協議，交付與收入認列尚待完成。
text.en: Ainos disclosed an ASE purchase of 5,000 chemical sensing systems worth US$9m, with new deliveries and revenue recognition still pending.

title.zh: 精材與台積電簽先進封裝產能外包協議，首期量產規劃 2029 年
title.en: Xintec signs TSMC packaging outsourcing agreement, targets first output in 2029

summary.zh: 精材 11 月 13 日公告與台積電簽署先進封裝後段製程產能外包協議，合作至 2033 年 12 月 31 日，預計在台積電中部科學園區廠房建置及營運 CoWoS 的 oS 模組產線。精材董事會另通過擬發行 150 億元轉換公司債，首期量產目標為 2029 年；融資核准與未來量產均不代表產線已完成驗收。
summary.en: Xintec disclosed a capacity-outsourcing agreement with TSMC on November 13, covering the on-substrate stage of advanced packaging at TSMC's Central Taiwan Science Park facilities through December 31, 2033. Xintec also approved a proposed NT$15 billion convertible-bond issuance to support its buildout, with first-phase production targeted for 2029; the financing decision and production target do not establish completed qualification.

text.zh: 精材規劃在台積電設施內建置及營運先進封裝後段的 oS 模組產線，涉及晶片、封裝基板、組裝設備、製程測試及自動物料搬運。CoWoS 產線的實際產能、良率與客戶驗收須與簽約日期分開閱讀。
text.en: Xintec plans to build and operate the CoWoS on-substrate back-end stage within TSMC's site. Relevant processes include chip-to-substrate integration, assembly tools, test and automated material handling. Output, yield and customer acceptance are separate from the contract signing.

text.zh: 公開資訊觀測站重大訊息經台視轉載，載明事實發生日為 11 月 13 日，契約對象為台積電，結束日為 2033 年 12 月 31 日。董事會通過 150 億元轉換公司債發行計畫，用於初期產線建置；此為融資額度決議，並非已認列的設備採購支出。
text.en: A reproduced stock-exchange material-event notice dates the agreement November 13 and identifies TSMC as the counterparty, with expiry on December 31, 2033. The NT$15 billion convertible-bond decision concerns planned financing for initial construction, not recognized equipment expenditure.

label.zh: 量產規劃與未公開項目

text.zh: 精材稱首期產線計畫於 2029 年量產，並規劃投入生產設備及自動物料搬運系統。公告未列晶圓月產能、各工站設備清單、客戶驗收日期、融資發行條件或訂單金額。
text.en: Xintec targets initial mass production in 2029 and plans capital expenditure on process tools and automated material handling. Wafer-equivalent capacity, equipment lists, acceptance dates, bond terms and order value were not disclosed.

text.zh: 首期線體的確切產能、良率、驗收里程碑、轉換公司債實際發行結果及出貨時程尚未公開。
text.en: Exact line capacity, yields, acceptance milestones, bond issuance outcome and shipments remain unknown.

title.zh: 日月光路竹廠一期啟用、二期動土，滿載後總投資規模估千億元
title.en: ASE opens Luzhu phase one and breaks ground on phase two, estimates NT$100bn total investment

summary.zh: 日月光 11 月 13 日於南部科學園區高雄園區啟用路竹廠一期，並同步為二期動土。公司表示兩期滿載後總投資規模估達 1,000 億元，屆時年營收約 800 億元、就業約 5,000 人；後兩項均為未來滿載情境的公司估計，未提供已驗收的新增封裝產能數量。
summary.en: ASE inaugurated phase one of its Luzhu advanced-packaging site and broke ground on phase two at Southern Taiwan Science Park's Kaohsiung campus on November 13. The company estimates roughly NT$100 billion in combined investment after both phases are fully built out, with potential annual revenue of NT$80 billion and about 5,000 jobs; those figures are forward estimates, not realized output.

text.zh: 一期已舉行啟用典禮，二期當日動土，兩者工程進度不同。公司說明廠區由高雄楠梓延伸到路竹，預計支援先進封裝與封測製程的設備、材料及廠務需求。
text.en: Phase one was inaugurated while phase two broke ground the same day, representing different project stages. ASE describes an expansion from its existing Nanzih base to Luzhu, involving advanced packaging, test, equipment, materials and utilities.

text.zh: 官方新聞稿指出兩期滿載後整體投資規模估為 1,000 億元，未來年營收估 800 億元，規劃創造約 5,000 個工作機會。公司另提到此前已投入 65 億元取得既有廠房及附屬設施，此金額不可在不明確拆分範圍下直接加總至整體千億元預估。
text.en: The official release puts estimated investment at NT$100 billion after both phases reach full buildout, possible annual revenue at NT$80 billion and planned employment at about 5,000. ASE also notes earlier NT$6.5 billion spending on existing buildings and related facilities; it cannot be automatically added to the aggregate plan without a scope reconciliation.

text.zh: 二期設計包含微振動控制，並將特殊氣體、危險物品及廢水處理區域分棟，反映封裝製程環境與工廠安全管理需求。官方未公告細部封裝產品組合及各工站投產日。
text.en: Phase two's planned facilities include micro-vibration controls and separated buildings for special gases, hazardous materials and wastewater, reflecting packaging process-environment requirements. Product mix and individual line commissioning dates were not provided.

text.zh: 兩期實際資本支出進度、設備規格、每月封裝產能、各產線良率及客戶驗收時間仍未公布。
text.en: Actual phase-by-phase spending, equipment specifications, monthly packaging capacity, yields and customer acceptance dates are not public.

title.zh: 技嘉第三季營收約 1,547 億元，前九月伺服器占比達 78%
title.en: Gigabyte reports NT$154.7bn Q3 sales, with servers at 78% of nine-month revenue

summary.zh: 技嘉 11 月 13 日法說指出，第三季合併營收約 1,547 億元、年增 94.4%，營業利益 128.38 億元、歸母淨利 85.71 億元，每股盈餘 12.8 元。前九月伺服器營收比重達 78%，公司並提及台灣平鎮、美國洛杉磯及馬來西亞新山廠擴產；2027 年 40 億元資本支出仍為規劃，未公布各地新增機櫃產能。
summary.en: Gigabyte said at its November 13 briefing that Q3 revenue was about NT$154.7 billion, up 94.4% YoY, operating profit was NT$12.838 billion, attributable profit was NT$8.571 billion and EPS was NT$12.8. Servers represented 78% of its first-nine-month revenue, and management described capacity expansion in Pingzhen, Los Angeles and Johor Bahru; the planned NT$4 billion 2027 capex is guidance, without new rack-unit capacity by location.

text.zh: 技嘉涵蓋主機板、顯示卡、伺服器及系統整合，AI 伺服器需搭配晶片、記憶體、機櫃電力與散熱系統。公司前九月伺服器營收已超過 3,100 億元，但未揭露各平台單獨的 GPU 機櫃驗收量。
text.en: Gigabyte supplies motherboards, graphics systems, servers and integration services, with server systems involving processors, memory, rack power and cooling. First-nine-month server revenue exceeded NT$310 billion, but unit-level GPU-rack acceptances were not published.

text.zh: 中央社報導第三季營收約 1,547 億元、年增 94.4%，毛利率 14%，營業利益 128.38 億元、歸母淨利 85.71 億元、營益率 8.3%，每股盈餘 12.8 元。證券資訊網站轉載的第三季合併損益表載營收 1,547.11244 億元、毛利 216.61413 億元，前九月合併營收 4,039.83007 億元；各數字依財報及管理層說明口徑標示。
text.en: CNA reported Q3 revenue of roughly NT$154.7 billion, up 94.4%, gross margin of 14%, operating income of about NT$12.8 billion, operating margin of 8.3% and EPS of NT$12.8. A reproduced consolidated income statement lists precise Q3 sales of NT$154.711244 billion and gross profit of NT$21.661413 billion, operating profit of NT$12.838234 billion and attributable net profit of NT$8.571372 billion, with nine-month sales of NT$403.983007 billion.

text.zh: 管理階層表示平鎮南平廠、洛杉磯廠與馬來西亞新山廠將持續擴產。2026 年資本支出預計約 28 至 30 億元，2027 年規劃 40 億元；這是未來資本配置估計，非已完成的建廠支出或客戶採購。
text.en: Management outlined further expansion at the Pingzhen Nanping plant in Taiwan, Los Angeles and Johor Bahru, Malaysia. Expected 2026 capital spending is NT$2.8–3.0 billion and planned 2027 spending is NT$4 billion; these budgets do not establish completed construction or customer purchases.

text.zh: 未公布馬來西亞新增產能、機櫃出貨台數、電源與冷卻規格、長約訂單金額及各廠實際稼動率。
text.en: Malaysian capacity additions, rack units, power and cooling specifications, contracted order value and site utilization remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 台灣第三季半導體產值 2.662 兆元，工研院估全年 9.762 兆元
title.en: Taiwan Q3 semiconductor output reaches NT$2.662T; ITRI forecasts NT$9.762T for 2026

summary.zh: 台灣半導體產業協會 11 月 13 日發布工研院產科國際所統計，2026 年第三季台灣半導體業產值達 2 兆 6,620 億元，季增 19.3%、年增 59.4%；其中記憶體產值 2,491 億元，年增 340.1%。工研院另預估全年產值約 9 兆 7,615 億元、年增 49.7%，年度數字屬預測，不能當成已實現全年產出。
summary.en: TSIA released ITRI's Taiwan semiconductor statistics on November 13: Q3 output reached NT$2.662 trillion, up 19.3% QoQ and 59.4% YoY, including memory output of NT$249.1 billion, up 340.1% YoY. ITRI forecasts approximately NT$9.7615 trillion for full-year 2026, up 49.7%, which remains a forecast rather than realized annual output.

text.zh: 第三季 IC 設計產值 5,368 億元，製造 1 兆 8,656 億元，其中晶圓代工 1 兆 6,165 億元、記憶體及其他製造 2,491 億元；封裝 1,785 億元、測試 811 億元。各產業段的產值分類須依協會定義閱讀，記憶體包含於 IC 製造，不能再重複加總。
text.en: Q3 IC design output was NT$536.8 billion and manufacturing NT$1,865.6 billion, including foundry NT$1,616.5 billion and memory/other manufacturing NT$249.1 billion. Packaging was NT$178.5 billion and testing NT$81.1 billion. Memory is included within manufacturing, so subcomponents must not be added twice.

text.zh: 工研院估第四季產值 2 兆 9,421 億元、季增 10.5%；2026 年全年 9 兆 7,615 億元、年增 49.7%。全年晶圓代工預估約 6 兆 249 億元，記憶體及其他製造預估 7,959 億元，均非已完成的第四季結果。
text.en: ITRI forecasts NT$2,942.1 billion of Q4 output, up 10.5% QoQ, and NT$9,761.5 billion for full-year 2026, up 49.7% YoY. Its full-year foundry forecast is NT$6,024.9 billion and memory/other manufacturing NT$795.9 billion, neither representing completed Q4 data.

text.zh: 本次找到的詳細數值出自中央社及其他媒體引述協會與工研院，尚未取得可逐欄比對的原始季度統計表及全年預測模型。
text.en: Detailed figures were obtained from news reports attributing the data to TSIA and ITRI; an original line-by-line quarterly table and forecast model were not independently retrieved.

title.zh: 日月光增購 5,000 台 Ainos 化學感測設備，合約金額 900 萬美元
title.en: ASE orders 5,000 additional Ainos chemical sensors under a US$9m agreement

summary.zh: Ainos 於美國時間 11 月 12 日宣布與日月光簽訂 900 萬美元採購協議，新增 5,000 台 AI Nose 化學感測系統，將應用於先進封裝製造環境監測。此前 210 萬美元協議所涵蓋的 1,400 台已交付，但新訂單的交貨、付款與收入認列仍依協議條件進行。
summary.en: Ainos announced on November 12 US time that ASE had signed a US$9 million purchase agreement for 5,000 additional AI Nose chemical sensing systems for advanced-packaging manufacturing environments. All 1,400 systems in the earlier US$2.1 million agreement had been delivered, while shipment, payment and revenue recognition under the new agreement remain subject to its terms.

label.zh: 製程監測與供應鏈用途

text.zh: AI Nose 將環境空氣中的化學訊號轉換為可供分析的數據，Ainos 說明其目標是補充既有設備及製程量測資料，用於污染物偵測、異常調查與現場安全。這些功能仍須在特定客戶製程條件下持續驗證。
text.en: AI Nose digitizes airborne chemical signals to supplement existing equipment and process metrology, according to Ainos, with intended uses in contamination monitoring, anomaly investigation and facility safety. Performance remains subject to application-specific validation.

label.zh: 合約條款及已交付部分

text.zh: Ainos 官方發布的新聞稿列出新訂單金額 900 萬美元、5,000 台，簽約後 60 天內應支付 450 萬美元訂金，剩餘款項以交付文件請款；此前 1,400 台已完成交付。新合約價值與當期營收認列不可混用。
text.en: The company's release specifies US$9 million for 5,000 systems, a US$4.5 million deposit due within 60 days of signing and the remainder invoiced following delivery documentation. The earlier 1,400 units were delivered. Contract value is distinct from recognized quarterly revenue.

text.zh: 新一批 5,000 台的實際交付排程、各廠分布、完成驗收數量與製程良率改善幅度尚未揭露。
text.en: Delivery schedule, plant allocation, accepted units and quantified yield improvement for the new 5,000 systems are not public.

title.zh: 燿華宜蘭廠啟動 5.04MW 表後儲能建置，預計 2027 年 6 月完工
title.en: Unitech begins 5.04MW behind-the-meter storage buildout at Yilan factory

summary.zh: 聚恆科技與燿華電子 11 月 12 日啟動宜蘭廠表後儲能工程，規劃容量 5.04MW／10.03MWh，預定 2027 年 6 月完工。工程將搭配 H-ELink 能源管理系統進行尖離峰調度；聚恆預估每年可節省逾 1,200 萬元電費，這是專案預測，尚無運轉後實績。
summary.en: Juheng and PCB manufacturer Unitech started a behind-the-meter battery project at Unitech's Yilan factory on November 12, planning 5.04MW of power and 10.03MWh of storage for June 2027 completion. The H-ELink energy management system is intended for peak/off-peak dispatch; estimated savings above NT$12 million annually are a project forecast, not operating results.

text.zh: 燿華的 PCB 生產涉及工廠用電與供電管理，表後儲能配置在用戶端電表後側，規劃以尖離峰電價及需量反應條件進行調度。此工程與整廠資料中心電力不同，應依燿華宜蘭廠個別需求評估。
text.en: PCB fabrication requires plant-level power management. Behind-the-meter storage is located on the customer's side of the meter and may dispatch against peak/off-peak prices and demand-response programs. This project concerns Unitech's factory, not a data-center electrical installation.

text.zh: 聚恆公布規劃 5.04MW 輸出功率與 10.03MWh 儲能容量，預計 2027 年 6 月竣工；每年節省超過 1,200 萬元的說法仍屬企業估計。11 月 12 日已開始工程，未表示系統已併網投運。
text.en: The disclosed design comprises 5.04MW of output and 10.03MWh of energy storage, targeting June 2027 completion. Savings exceeding NT$12 million annually are the contractor's estimate. Work commenced November 12, but the battery had not been declared commissioned.

text.zh: 未取得設備供應商明細、電池化學體系、系統實測效率、電力交易資格及竣工驗收資料。
text.en: Equipment vendors, battery chemistry, measured efficiency, electricity-market eligibility and commissioning certificates were not published.

title.zh: 追蹤：華紙以 27.8 億元出售觀音廠予元太，元太取得既有承租場址
title.en: Follow-up: E Ink to acquire the Guanyin plant it partly leases for NT$2.78bn

summary.zh: 中華紙漿 11 月 13 日宣布，董事會通過以新台幣 27.8 億元出售桃園觀音廠土地、廠房及附屬設備給元太科技，預估處分利益 13.3 億元。元太此前已承租廠區部分空間作為生產據點；本次是廠房資產交易，未公告新增 PTFE 材料月產能或投產驗收。
summary.en: Chung Hwa Pulp said on November 13 its board approved the NT$2.78 billion sale of land, buildings and associated equipment at its Guanyin plant in Taoyuan to E Ink, estimating NT$1.33 billion in disposal gains. E Ink had already leased part of the site for production; the property transaction does not establish additional PTFE material capacity or completed qualification.

label.zh: 材料供應鏈與關係企業

text.zh: 華紙表示元太原已承租觀音廠部分區域並依租約享有優先承購權，本次處分對象為關係人。交易與元太的既有材料加工據點相連，但公告未把購地面積直接對應任何高速基板材料產能。
text.en: Chung Hwa Pulp said E Ink already leased part of the Guanyin site and held contractual purchase priority. The related-party property sale concerns E Ink's existing manufacturing location, without an announced link between floor area and high-speed substrate material output.

text.zh: 交易總金額 27.8 億元，華紙估扣除成本、費用與稅賦後將認列處分利益約 13.3 億元，預計於第四季認列。賣方估計收益與買方資本支出屬不同財務口徑。
text.en: The agreed consideration is NT$2.78 billion. Chung Hwa Pulp estimates roughly NT$1.33 billion of disposal gains after costs and taxes, expected to be recognized in Q4. The seller's estimated gain and the buyer's acquisition amount are different accounting measures.

text.zh: 不動產移轉完成日、元太後續設備改造、PTFE 生產分配、專案量產能力及客戶驗證均未揭露。
text.en: Closing date, E Ink's equipment conversion, allocation to PTFE production, plant capacity and customer qualification remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 神基稱取得兩筆歐美無人載具專案訂單，強固型工業電腦供地面控制系統
title.en: Getac reports two US and European unmanned-system projects involving rugged ground controls

summary.zh: 神基投控 11 月 13 日法說指出，2026 年取得兩筆來自歐洲與美國客戶的無人載具大型專案訂單，業務涉及強固型電腦及地面控制站；公司預估 2027 年無人機相關業務占比約 5% 至 10%。第三季合併營收約 114.31 億元，但未公開這兩筆訂單的金額、履約時程或確切數量。
summary.en: Getac Holdings said at its November 13 briefing that it won two large unmanned-system projects from European and US customers in 2026, involving rugged computing and ground-control applications. Management expects this business to represent roughly 5%–10% of 2027 revenue; Q3 group revenue was about NT$11.431 billion, but project value, delivery timing and volumes were not provided.

label.zh: 工業電腦及終端系統背景

text.zh: 神基的強固型電腦可用於工業、戶外及專業現場作業，無人載具地面控制系統涉及終端電腦、通訊介面、功率管理與環境耐受度測試。公司公開資訊未將訂單轉化為個別零組件採購量。
text.en: Getac's rugged computers support industrial and field applications, while unmanned-platform ground control involves computing terminals, communications interfaces, power management and environmental testing. The announcement did not quantify purchases of particular components.

text.zh: 公司稱兩筆大型專案分別來自歐洲與美國客戶，並預估明年相關業務占比 5% 至 10%。第三季合併營收約 114.31 億元，季減 0.7%；歸母淨利約 12.86 億元，季減 18.2%，每股盈餘 2.06 元。未公開專案總金額及單台系統規格。
text.en: The company described two projects, one from Europe and one from the United States, and forecasts a 5%–10% revenue mix next year. Q3 revenue was approximately NT$11.431 billion, down 0.7% QoQ, and attributable net profit NT$1.286 billion, down 18.2%, with EPS NT$2.06. Contract value and unit-level specifications were not disclosed.

text.zh: 尚未公開客戶名稱、交付件數、個別控制終端規格、產線稼動率或實際出貨日期。
text.en: Customer names, delivery units, individual control-terminal specifications, manufacturing utilization and actual shipment dates remain unpublished.

ceoView.zh: 對強固型電源、嵌入式電腦量測與工業控制儀器供應商而言，兩筆專案揭露了應用領域，但沒有個別規格或出貨時程。應查核終端負載、耐候與電磁相容測試要求、供應範圍及驗收里程碑，營收占比預估不代表已交付數量。
ceoView.en: For rugged power, embedded-computer metrology and industrial control instrument suppliers, the two awards identify an application area without specific electrical requirements or shipment schedules. Terminal loads, environmental and EMC testing, supply scope and acceptance milestones remain unknown; forecast revenue mix is not delivered volume.

question.zh: 精材的 150 億元與 2029 年代表什麼階段？
question.en: What do Xintec's NT$15bn and 2029 represent?

text.zh: 150 億元是董事會通過的轉換公司債發行規劃，2029 年是首期產線量產目標。尚無可核對的設備採購細項及產能驗收資料。
text.en: NT$15bn is approved proposed convertible-bond financing, while 2029 is the target for first-phase production. Equipment procurement and qualified output remain undisclosed.

question.zh: 日月光的千億元與 800 億元是否已入帳？
question.en: Are ASE's NT$100bn investment and NT$80bn sales already recognized?

text.zh: 兩筆都屬兩期滿載後的公司估計。一期啟用與二期動土已發生，但未來年營收及全案投資不可當成目前季度實績。
text.en: Both amounts are management estimates for full buildout. Phase one opened and phase two broke ground, but future annual revenue and full-project investment are not current-quarter actuals.

question.zh: 台灣半導體第三季產值和全年預估如何比較？
question.en: How should Q3 output and the full-year estimate be compared?

text.zh: 2.662 兆元是第三季產值統計，9.762 兆元是工研院對全年的預測。晶圓代工與記憶體均已含於 IC 製造分項，不能和總產值再次加總。
text.en: NT$2.662tn is reported Q3 output, while NT$9.762tn is ITRI's full-year forecast. Foundry and memory are subcomponents of manufacturing and cannot be added again to total output.

title.zh: 已發布的海外設廠補助

text.zh: 台積電 11 月 10 日申報的第三季財報列出 2026 年前九月約新台幣 1,675.87 億元政府補助相關現金流入，涵蓋海外子公司在美國、德國、日本及中國的設廠營運；此數據屬較早公布的財報背景，未作為新事件重刊。
text.en: TSMC's Q3 financial filing on November 10 reported approximately NT$167.587bn in government-grant proceeds for the first nine months across overseas operations in the United States, Germany, Japan and China. This previously disclosed filing is dated context, not a fresh event.

text.zh: 純股價變動、未公開採購或工程數據的評論，以及前一日報已收錄的華碩、鴻海和元太 PTFE 研發計畫，均未以新事件重刊。
text.en: Stock-price commentary, unsupported procurement claims and prior-edition coverage of ASUS, Foxconn and E Ink's PTFE development plan were not republished as new events.

verificationNote.zh: 精材合約重訊已由媒體轉載核對，但未取得交易所原始個別申報頁；TSIA 細部產值透過兩家媒體相互核對，尚缺原始分項統計表。神基與元太資產交易目前依公司法說或重大訊息的第二手報導，未獨立取得完整原始文件；相關金額、產能與未來目標已分開標示。
verificationNote.en: Xintec's material-event filing was checked in a reproduced report, but its original exchange filing page was not independently retrieved. TSIA's detailed segment data were cross-checked across two outlets without the original segment spreadsheet. Getac and E Ink's asset transaction currently rely on second-hand reporting of company statements; actual results and future targets are separately labeled.
